query: How should we compute/approximate KL when q has low-rank+diagonal covariance or when p(u) is an inducing-point sparse GP; what scalable algorithms and memory bounds apply per bag of size N?

response.query: How should we compute/approximate KL when q has low-rank+diagonal covariance or when p(u) is an inducing-point sparse GP; what scalable algorithms and memory bounds apply per bag of size N?
response.answer: Use the Nyström method for low-rank approximations and stochastic gradient-based methods for scalable computation of KL divergence in sparse GPs. Memory scales linearly with the bag size N.
